text: DEFONEOS — DEFRA Animal and Plant Health Agency AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DEFRA × ANIMAL & PLANT HEALTH DEFRA Animal and Plant Health Agency AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK Animal and Plant Health Agency — disease surveillance, import controls, food safety, plant health, and One Health biosecurity. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Surveillance Disease Surveillance Notifiable disease monitoring — avian influenza, BSE, foot-and-mouth, bluetongue, African swine fever. Real-time syndromic surveillance from veterinary reports. Wild bird surveillance for HPAI H5N1/H5N8. Sentinel flock and herd monitoring. Serological screening and PCR confirmation. Disease-free status under OIE/WOAH codes. Outbreak modelling with epidemiological contact tracing. Cross-border intelligence via EU TRACES and OIE WAHIS. Seasonal risk forecasting for vector-borne diseases. Rapid diagnostics pipeline from field to confirmed case. Import Import Controls Border Target Operating Model (BTOM) for SPS checks. SPS certificate verification at border control points. Risk-based import categorisation (low/medium/high). IPAFFS digital gateway processing. Physical inspection scheduling at inland border facilities. Cold chain integrity verification for perishables. Third-country establishment audit trail. CHED processing. Emergency safeguard measures for emerging threats. Border Force and HMRC coordination. Plants Plant Health Plant passport regime for intra-GB and GB-to-NI movements. Xylella fastidiosa surveillance and rapid response. Ash dieback monitoring and woodland management. Sweet chestnut blight containment zones. Oak processionary moth outbreak management. Phytophthora ramorum statutory eradication. Phytosanitary certificate validation. Protected Zone designations for quarantine pests. Seed testing and certification. Interception reporting from ports and garden centres. Food Safety Food Safety FSA liaison for zoonotic disease intelligence. Salmonella, Campylobacter, E. coli O157, Listeria surveillance. AMR monitoring in food-producing animals. Food chain information from abattoirs and processors. Meat hygiene inspection and post-mortem data. BSE specified risk material controls. Food incident response with FSA and local authorities. Shellfish biotoxin monitoring. Radionuclide monitoring in food. Mycotoxin and contaminant surveillance in animal feed. Livestock Livestock Traceability Cattle tracing via BCMS (CTS Online). Sheep EID movement recording. Pig identification and AMLS movement system. Poultry register and premises identification. Horse passport and Equine Database. Movement licence issuance and standstill enforcement. Birth, death, and movement notification. Cross-border rules under Windsor Framework. Livestock haulier biosecurity compliance. Market and gathering disease transmission assessment. Laboratories Laboratory Network APHA Weybridge — OIE Reference Laboratory. Regional lab network (Starcross, Bury St Edmunds, Thirsk, Penrith, Carmarthen). Diagnostic capacity management for outbreak surge. Sample chain-of-custody from field to result. PCR, ELISA, virus isolation, histopathology automation. Turnaround monitoring (routine vs urgent vs statutory). EQA and proficiency testing. 7-day mandatory specimen retention. Biobank management for archived samples. LIMS integration across sites. Wildlife Wildlife Protection Wildlife crime intelligence with NPCC-compliant handling. Raptor persecution monitoring (hen harrier, golden eagle, peregrine). Invasive alien species management (grey squirrel, signal crayfish). CITES enforcement for illegal wildlife trade. Badger sett survey and TB reservoir management. Bat protection during development works. Wildlife incident investigation. Non-native

register.note: CSOAI measures and publishes evidence. It issues no conformity marks and holds no accreditation. Nothing here is certification or legal advice.
